title: Stockham Construction
description:
Stockham Construction, Inc. is a commercial union subcontractor with over 30 years of experience specializing in interior and exterior metal stud framing, drywall, finish taping, acoustical ceilings, and commercial door installation. The company is dedicated to quality, integrity, and client satisfaction, aiming to build lasting partnerships that contribute to the success of their clients' ventures. They serve a diverse range of commercial construction projects, including advanced technology, health services, and education sectors, ensuring high standards of quality and precision. Their collaborative approach integrates multiple trades to streamline the construction process, delivering exceptional results while minimizing disruptions. 
The company headquarters is located in 475 Portal Street, Cotati, CA 94931, United States. 201-500 Employees
